name: Spec Authoring
description: Primitives, relations, validation rules, and renderers for authoring FDPM-style SPEC documents (SPEC-CORE / SPEC-MCP-SERVER house style). Models a SPEC as a typed object graph — Document, Sections, Stakeholders, Quality Attributes, ADRs, Options, Open Questions, References, Terms, Requirements — and renders the full Markdown SPEC with the canonical structure (frontmatter, PALS banner, disclaimer, numbered sections, ADR, trade-off matrix, references).
